title: StockSmart Recurring Program Fees Still to Post in a Commercial Credit Account Room Payment
content:
A room payment on a Commercial Credit Account counts **the StockSmart billing still to post**, an amount added to the receivable balance, read from the program fees charged on the customer's StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program programs.

### Clause

The StockSmart billing still to post is a share of the recurring program fees, meaning the monthly minimum and onsite management fees, charged across all the customer's StockSmart programs less than one whole month before today: the whole of them when such fees were charged in each of the months less than one whole month, one whole month and two whole months before today, one half of them when such fees were charged in exactly two of those three months, and one quarter of them otherwise.

Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the fee date and today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the fee date's day of the month. A fee "one whole month before today" is one dated exactly one whole month before today, and likewise for two.

### Share table

| Months among the three with recurring fees | Billing still to post |
|---|---|
| all three | the whole (100 percent) of the recurring fees charged less than one whole month before today |
| exactly two | one half (50 percent) of them |
| one or none | one quarter (25 percent) of them |

Other program fees (setup, emergency visit, trip, bin and change fees, early exit) are not recurring fees and are not counted.

### Example (hypothetical, today 20 May)

Monthly minimum fees of 250.00 dated 30 April and 31 March, none in the month before: recurring fees less than one whole month before today total 250.00, fees fall in exactly two of the three months, and the billing still to post is 125.00.
